audit.whatIsWrong: Every level-chart row was wrong in both layers relative to the packet chart, the mirror audit and this page's own whys: Level 1 read 'Skill' while whys[0] says the level is yours by default; Level 3 read Renekton while whys[2] says neither side has an advantage; Levels 4-5, First item and 2+ items read Skill/Renekton while whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] all describe Gangplank taking over. Ratings were a flat 5-6/10 across a 45.92% matchup.
audit.why: 45.92% over 2500 games. Mirror (gangplank__renekton) locked the chart as L1 Renekton, L2 Renekton, L3 Skill, L4-5 Gangplank, L6 Skill, First item Gangplank, 2+ Gangplank; my ratings are the inverse of theirs (3/3/5/7/5/8/9).
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one atomic group, sides paired full+content, ratings 7/7/5/3/5/2/1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item row sold Eclipse as your spike; the item that decides that window is Gangplank's Trinity Force.
audit.why: spikes[2] on the same page already says Trinity Force turns barrel chains into burst that out-trades you.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now names Trinity Force landing against your Eclipse; phases[6].why names the two-item crit pattern and the global R.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated on the full layer: Remove Scurvy (W) cures crowd control, so it cleanses your W stun outright and heals him through the trade. Powder Keg's real detonation mechanic (he must attack the keg) was reduced to 'pop barrels to deny poke + gold', and Cannon Barrage's true damage was never mentioned.
audit.why: Gangplank kit: W 'cures crowd control effects and restore Health', 22/20/18/16/14s. E kegs armed at 1000 range, detonated by his attack — his Parrrley reaches 625. R carries the trueDamage flag.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy's cleanse, heal and 22s rank-1 cooldown stated in report[5].t; keg detonation stated in dosFull[0].d; anti-heal purchase tied to it in report[8].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing anywhere on the page against a champion whose W is a heal.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy restores health on a 14-22s cooldown; extended trades hinge on it.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling added to the itemization line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'late' block writes 'Powder Kegs' as if it were the ability name; Riot's name is Powder Keg (singular).
audit.why: Packet flagged it as a probable wrong ability name; enemyKit confirms 'Powder Keg'.
audit.corrected: Reworded to 'clusters of live kegs' so no fabricated plural name is presented as the ability.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force lands beside your Eclipse and out-trades it — force the fight before his completes.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two-item Gangplank crits through you with barrel chains and zones every objective with a global R — close the game before this.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy cures your stun and heals him — 22s at rank 1. Bait it out, then E-W-Q him on the whiff.

edits.before: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: He must attack a keg to detonate it — kill it first, or stand off the blast.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Eclipse  (burst + the early bully curve), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Eclipse, then Executioner's Calling early — Remove Scurvy heals through chip; boots Plated Steelcaps.

edits.before: Two-item Gangplank — Trinity Force plus Infinity Edge or Essence Reaver — ends the 1v1 entirely. His barrel chains crit through your HP and his global Cannon Barrage (R) makes every objective a coin flip you have no control over. Your job at this point is not to win the duel; it is to have already converted your Level 2 and Level 6 leads into tower damage or jungle pressure. Do not chase him into his barrel minefield, do not stand near clusters of Powder Kegs, and do not fight him without your team present. He out-scales you cleanly and you need to accept that.
edits.after: Two-item Gangplank — Trinity Force plus Infinity Edge or Essence Reaver — ends the 1v1 entirely. His barrel chains crit through your HP and his global Cannon Barrage (R) deals true damage, so stacking armour answers nothing. Your job at this point is not to win the duel; it is to have already converted your Level 2 and Level 6 leads into tower damage or jungle pressure. Do not chase him into his keg minefield, do not stand near clusters of live Powder Keg (E), and do not fight him without your team present. He out-scales you cleanly.
